summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.

Never run Bandit on ledgerly without invoking it through ./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh so its custom exclusions and baseline comparison are applied.

Operator: can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Finish and validate invoice-list pagination with an envelope containing `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery visibility_timeout to six hours made stuck jobs invisible for hours; do not retry. Default-locale CSV output caused encoding failures. Per-document embedding clients and per-vector transactions caused duplicate work and poor performance.

## Recent work
Optimized invoice summaries: reduced tenant 73 from 2,417 SQL queries and 38.6s to 37 queries and 4.27s while preserving 14,802 aggregates. Added batched currency conversion and a stable 37-query regression test. All 63 report tests passed, with 2 PostgreSQL skips; Ruff and whitespace checks passed. Pagination tests and broader billing tests also passed, but no pagination commit has been reported.

Default-locale CSV output caused encoding failures; per-document embedding clients and per-vector transactions caused duplicate work and poor performance.
